topics.topic: Whether EffectAttempt records are required for read operations or only non-read/approval-gated effect classes
questions: For which operation effect classes must an EffectAttempt exist: only non-read effects, only approval-gated effects, or all operation calls including `read`?
Must EffectAttempt be created for `read` operation nodes, or only for non-read effect classes (`draft-write`, `state-transition`, `external-effect`, `destructive`)?

quotes: The record written before an effect is sent, so that a crash or an unclear answer leaves a known unknown instead of a silent one (K-08). Read by the run's recovery after restart and by the owner resolving an unknown outcome.
- `authority`: the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send the flow activation of the run's version (State 2, A10);
judgement.divergence: One implementer creates EffectAttempt records for every operation node call including `read`; another creates them only for non-`read` classes where an effect may occur (`draft-write`, `state-transition`, `external-effect`, `destructive`). The owner and agent notice this in inspect/read-trace outputs (presence or absence of EffectAttempt records for read nodes), and the owner may also notice different waiting/resolution behavior if `unknown` is represented for reads.
judgement.why: State 1 ties EffectAttempt to “an effect” and gives authority cases for non-read sends, but it never explicitly closes whether `read` operation calls are included or excluded.

topics.topic: Canonical request_digest coverage for credential-backed headers under credential rotation
questions: When request headers include credential-backed values, what exact header representation is covered by request_digest so that credential rotation does not invalidate an already approved request?

topics.topic: Definition of "recent" evidence for the agent repair read path
questions: What exactly counts as "recent" evidence for the repair read path?

topics.topic: Mutability/reload policy for non-token installation fields during process lifetime
questions: Are non-token installation fields (manifest revision/location, service instance selection, credentials refs, MCP listen address) immutable for process lifetime, or can they be reloaded without restart?

topics.topic: Precedence and state handling when both per-run approval and standing grant are simultaneously available
questions: If both authorities are simultaneously available for the same operation send (an applicable unused approval and an active standing grant), which one must the kernel use and record, and what must happen to the other authority's state?

topics.topic: Whether run invocation facts are pinned at run start or re-read on each attempt/resume
questions: For operation nodes, does a run pin manifest-derived invocation facts (base URL, required headers, instance selection, record digest check context) at run start, or are they re-read at each attempt/resume?

topics.topic: Whether selected service-instance facts are part of ManifestOperation identity even when record_digest is unchanged
questions: If the selected service instance changes (thus base URL/headers/class) while the operation `record_digest` stays the same, is that a different ManifestOperation fact for propose/accept/invoke reads?

topics.topic: Whether spooled-file reads are a distinct kernel surface action
questions: Is `read_spooled_file` a separate kernel surface action, or must spooled-file bytes be reachable only through existing listed actions?

topics.topic: Which effect classes are eligible for standing grants (e.g., read/draft-write)
questions: Can the owner create a standing grant for `read` or `draft-write` operation nodes that never require per-run approval?

topics.topic: disclosure_class assignment for zero-input trial cases
questions: If a trial case has no inputs (function with zero input ports), what disclosure_class is assigned to expected outputs and trial execution outputs?
